spec.title: Rover safe route to Gusev summit
assumptions: Terrain: real elevation data, Gusev / Columbia Hills area (Spirit), Mars (U01 uncontrolled) (80 m square, 24.1 m of relief, typical slope 18.1°). Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona HiRISE DTM.
Gave the robot up to 89 s to reach the goal: 29.5 m at about 0.83 m/s, times 2.5, kept within 20–120 s.

report.limits_scope: Limits apply to mars gravity (3.71 m/s²) and the regolith surface (base friction 0.70).
report.scan_note: No matching Finder result for this world for slope_deg, roughness, step, friction; ran a quick scan (10 of 16 allowed runs).
report.honesty: Map from measured limits (step ±1 cm, slope ±1.9°, …); real places combine features, so the map is checked with spot runs below.

spot_checks.label: Spot 1: the selected area
spot_checks.outcome: crossed without falling or getting stuck

spot_checks.label: Spot 2: the selected area
spot_checks.outcome: crossed without falling or getting stuck

report.agreement_text: 2 of 2 spot checks agreed with the map. Map flagged unreliable: fewer than 4 spot checks agreed.
report.headline: The rover can reach the summit (40.6 s). Driving straight there works too.

route.reason: Safe route found. The source map is flagged unreliable; this is a tentative route, not a safety guarantee.

runs.label: Straight
runs.ghost_status: not recorded (a replay re-simulates the same seed)

runs.label: Safe route
runs.ghost_status: not recorded (a replay re-simulates the same seed)

comparison.text: Straight: reached the goal in 34.2 s. Safe route: reached the goal in 40.6 s, 2% longer path. Source map flagged unreliable; route evidence does not certify the whole map.
